_note: Episode 22 (S3E2) keyframes (from Kabanata 22, story version 2). Babel follows Genesis 11 with respect: God is never shown, no figure in the sky, only light and the confusion of the people. The scripture image is an old closed or open Bible with no readable text. The hairy giant builders are the story's fiction. Usman appears only in the lagusan light and inside the jump. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
